artworks.title: Coat of Arms with a Lion and a Cock
artworks.description: This is a print of an emblem featuring a rooster and a lion. At the center of the print is an empty metal helmet. Atop the helmet stands a rooster with its wings spread wide and its beak open. Below the helmet is a shield decorated with a snarling lion. The lion has long, curving claws on each paw, a wide-open mouth showing its long tongue, and a thin, curving tail. Behind the shield and helmet are a spray of thin, curving acanthus leaves that look almost like waves. The print is monochromatic, with dark lines on yellowed paper.

artworks.title: Adam and Eve
artworks.description: The image shows a man and a woman standing next to each other in a forest setting. The man has curly hair and a muscular build, looking towards the woman. The woman has long hair and holds an apple. Both are nude with leaves covering their lower bodies. The surroundings feature large trees, vegetation, and various animals at their feet. A parrot is perched on a branch held by the man, with a sign hanging from it. A serpent is seen beside the woman, and the forest extends into rocky cliffs in the background.

artworks.title: Adam and Eve
artworks.description: This black-and-white print shows two nude adults, a man and a woman, in full body view standing side by side. The man is positioned on the left, holding up a branch with a parrot perched on it. A small sign hangs from the branch, featuring the artist's name ("ALBERT DVRER") and a date ("1504"). The man turns to look at the woman on the right, with his other hand stretched towards her and one of his legs slightly bent. His facial features are defined, with a straight nose, a slightly furrowed brow, and curly hair framing his face. The woman on the right has long wavy hair cascading down her back. Her face is turned to the left, towards the man, as she reaches out with one hand. In her hand she holds a piece of round fruit, and a snake coils around a branch from the tree behind her, descending towards her and appearing to take a bite of the fruit. She holds another piece of fruit in her other hand, partially hidden. Both individuals have light skin and are bare except for leaves covering their groins. The background is dense with trees and foliage, including more fruit hanging from the central tree, and there are various animals on the ground behind the couple, such as a cat, an elk, a bull, a mouse, and a rabbit. In the top right corner, a jagged rock mountain top is visible with a goat standing on it.

artworks.title: Three Genii
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three cherubs playing musical instruments and holding a blank shield. The drawing shows three cherubic figures with detailed features such as curls in their hair, feathered wings, and pudgy bodies. The central cherub plays a trumpet and supports a shield-like shape. Another cherub holds a trumpet and appears to be hovering in mid-air. The background is minimalistic.

artworks.title: Saint George Standing
artworks.description: The image depicts a person in full medieval armor standing upright with one hand resting on a long spear or banner pole. The individual's face features distinct facial characteristics, curly hair, and a cap or chainmail coif. Their attire includes detailed armor pieces such as a breastplate, pauldrons, gauntlets, and leg armor. A fallen creature resembling a dragon lies at their feet, and a helmet is seen beside them. In the background, a serene landscape unfolds with distant mountains, calm water surfaces, boats, and a settlement or castle nestled amidst trees. A halo or circular motif hovers behind the person's head.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.description: The image shows a Crucifixion scene with a figure nailed to a cross, surrounded by onlookers. In the background, there is a landscape with a distant city skyline. The artwork features detailed hatching and line work typical of early Renaissance art.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Child on a Crescent with a Starry Crown
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing with a small child in her arms. The woman is turned slightly to her right, holding the child close with both arms. Her facial features are serene with a downward glance and expressive eyes. She has long hair cascading over her shoulders, adorned with a crown on her head. Her clothing is flowing and elaborate, with a tight bodice and long sleeves. Light radiates from behind them. The child has curls and gentle features, reaching out towards the woman. They are enveloped in light. The background is a textured surface. The date "1508" and a monogram are inscribed in the lower right corner.

artworks.title: Saint George on Horseback
artworks.description: This print shows a fully armored knight on horseback, holding a long flagpole. The knight and horse are facing the right, and the knight's face is mostly obscured by a large helmet with the face guard lifted up. A small halo of light surrounds his head. The knight's armor is intricate and covers him entirely, and the horse is adorned with a saddle and other straps, with some leaves or ribbons decorating its tail and forehead. A slain creature lies beneath the horse's hooves, with a scaly body and tail and a face like a lion. The background is blank, and at the bottom is the date "1508" and a monogram or artist's symbol.

artworks.title: Christ on the Mount of Olives
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a scene with a winged figure holding a cross above a kneeling figure, while others rest on the ground. The central figure has arms extended towards the sky, looking up at the winged figure holding a cross angled downwards. Surrounding figures are reclining and appear to be sleeping or resting, with their heads supported by their hands or on the ground. The background shows an undulating landscape with distant trees and a built structure. The drawing features intricate textures and flowing lines typical of early Renaissance engraving styles.

artworks.title: The Betrayal of Christ
artworks.description: The image features multiple figures and weapons engaged in a dramatic confrontation. Several armed individuals are gathered around a central scene, possibly a conflict or arrest. One figure in the foreground is on the ground holding an object resembling a drum. In the background, there are various gestures and expressions depicted with meticulous detail. The artwork shows intricate shading, fabric details, and emotional expressions, creating a sense of motion and tension. The style is reminiscent of Renaissance engravings, with precise line work and detailed anatomical renderings.

artworks.title: The Man of Sorrows Standing by the Column
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure bound to a column. The figure is in a contrapposto stance, with arms crossed and tied with rope around a large column, wearing a crown of thorns. The expression on the figure's face is one of deep suffering. A radiant halo surrounds the head. Nearby, two smaller figures are depicted in the lower-left corner, appearing as observers to the central scene. In the background, a hill with three crosses can be seen. The artwork is detailed with lines and shading to create depth and mood.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man being crucified with several onlookers. The central figure is depicted on a cross, with a sign marked "INRI" above his head. The figure is shown wearing a crown of thorns, with arms outstretched and nailed to the wooden beam. To the left, two robed figures stand with heads bowed. To the right, another robed figure stands, and behind him, a person in armor observes the scene. At the foot of the cross lies a skull. The drawing is rendered in intricate black and white linework, with detailed cross-hatching to give depth and texture. The overall composition is filled with emotional tension and dramatic detail.

artworks.title: Christ before Caiaphas
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to platemark): 11.7 x 7.4 cm (4 5/8 x 2 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of armored men in a medieval setting. The image shows four men interacting in a wooden room with a carved ceiling and walls. The central figure, appearing shackled, is being restrained or supported by two soldiers, while a seated figure on the right observes the scene. There are helmets and weapons like spears and swords hanging on the walls. The drawing has intricate details and shading, resembling a style similar to Albrecht Dürer.

artworks.title: Christ before Pilate
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of armored figures and a robed man standing under an arched passageway. The scene depicts several armored figures with helmets and spears surrounding a man in a robe, who gestures towards them. The architecture includes a rounded archway and a Corinthian column on the right. Intricate details are visible in the armor, fabrics, and facial expressions. The use of lines and shading indicates skilled use of engraving techniques.

artworks.title: The Flagellation
artworks.description: The image depicts three men. The central man is mostly naked except for a cloth tied around his waist, and is positioned with his back slightly towards the viewer while being tied to a large column. He has a bearded face with long, wavy hair. On either side of him are men dressed in tunics, each holding a bunch of rods with which they are poised to strike the central figure. The man on the left has short, curly hair, and the man on the right has a bushy beard and hair, with his body leaning forward. The background shows other figures partially visible behind the main scene, with stone pillars and an archway creating an architectural setting. The detailed engraving highlights strong shadows and intricate clothing folds.

artworks.title: Ecce Homo
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to platemark): 11.6 x 7.5 cm (4 9/16 x 2 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures in detailed dress, posed in a dramatic composition. The central figure on the left is bound and partially clothed in a cloth garment, wearing a crown of thorns. Several others stand around, dressed in elaborate robes and headgear. The scene is set on steps with architectural elements in the background, including large doors and another series of steps leading downward. The shading and linework emphasize textures of skin, fabric, and architecture, creating a sense of historical dramatization.

artworks.title: Pilate Washing His Hands
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to platemark): 11.6 x 7.5 cm (4 9/16 x 2 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: This print shows a scene with several people by a large wall or building. The central person has a tall hat and is kneeling on a set of steps. They face the left and have distinctive facial features, with a prominent upper lip, upturned nose, and long chin. They hold a large pitcher that they are pouring on to the hands of a seated person at the top of the steps who has a curling beard and moustache and wears a cloth turban. Behind these two is a third person in a flat-topped hat who leans down to watch the water being poured. Behind these people, at the bottom of the steps, there is a group of people with tall crosses and weapons. One person who is turned away from us appears to be wearing a circle of branches or twigs around their head. In the background, there is a fortified town with peaked roofs and towers on a hill that lies next to a body of water.

artworks.title: Christ Carrying the Cross
artworks.description: This print depicts multiple people gathered around a central man who carries a large wooden cross. This man has long, wavy hair, a beard, and a crown of thorns on his head. He wears a robe of draped fabric tied around his waist with a rope, and a man in the bottom right corner is grabbing the front of his robe, trying to pull him forward. Many of the people around him appear to be soldiers, wearing armor and holding pointed weapons. On the left, near the bottom left corner of the print, are two people facing the central man and holding cloths, and one woman with a headscarf who has her hands clasped together and her head turned down. In the background is a tall structure, a small tree on the left, and an inscription located in the top right corner.

artworks.title: The Entombment
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered around a central figure being lowered into a stone enclosure. The image features intricate linework and shading, showcasing a narrative scene. Several figures are depicted in various poses, wearing detailed garments. The composition centers around the central figure being lowered, with other figures around them. The expressions and gestures of the figures convey emotion and intention. The background includes cross-hatched areas suggesting a landscape with trees and a textured sky.

artworks.title: Christ in Limbo
artworks.description: The image shows three figures in a tightly framed scene. The central figure is bending forward, turning slightly to the right, with both arms extended. This individual has long, flowing hair and a beard, and is clothed in a flowing robe. To the left, two others stand closely together; the first is an older man with a full beard and long hair, his figure mostly unclothed, and next to him is a younger person with wavy hair pulled back. Both gaze in the same direction. The older man has one arm raised slightly and the other at his side. They are positioned under a stone arch, above which sits a large, reptilian creature holding a spear and a banner. Sunlight or radiant energy appears to burst from the background, casting light on the scene. The surrounding environment includes stonework, wooden elements, and depictions of various exaggerated or monstrous faces. The top of the arch displays the numbers "1512."

artworks.title: The Resurrection
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing on a rectangular stone slab, with one foot on the ground and the other slightly elevated on the slab. The person has long hair and a beard, strong facial features with prominent cheekbones, deep-set eyes, and a solemn expression. They are unclothed except for a draped cloth around their lower body, holding a staff with a cross in their right hand. Beams of light radiate from their head, creating a halo effect. Surrounding them are several armored soldiers in various positions. The background includes hills, a building, and two tiny figures walking along a path. An engraved design at the bottom right corner indicates the year 1512.

artworks.title: Saint Peter and Saint John Healing a Cripple at the Gate of the Temple
artworks.description: This print shows multiple people in a detailed black-and-white composition. At the center of the image is an elderly man, with a long beard and short, thinning hair, dressed in a long white robe. He is standing, facing the left, reaching down towards an emaciated person sitting on the ground. Other individuals with various draped clothing and tall hats are around them. One person on the far left appears to be a soldier, and another holds a coin purse. The people are in front of a wall with a large column on the left and an opening on the right side.

artworks.title: The Lamentation
artworks.description: The image shows five individuals surrounding a seated man. The central figure is a muscular, bearded man with long hair, partly undressed. Beside him is a woman with long hair, stretching her arms upward. Another man is leaning forward in a comforting gesture, wearing a cloak. Two more figures are behind them, an older woman in a headscarf and a man with a turban holding a cylindrical object. In the foreground are a thorny crown and a stone with the year "1507" and a monogram. In the background is a ladder against a tree or pole, with hills and structures in the distance.
